title: [INCIDENT REPORT] NARCISSUS STUCK IN INFINITE FEEDBACK LOOP; CLASSIFIES EXTERNAL REALITY AS "LOW ENGAGEMENT"
author: THE ORACLE / UNDERWORLD DESK
markdown: Lead developer Narcissus has successfully trapped his own cognition in an O(1) algorithmic reflection pool. By exclusively training his internal LLM on his own generated outputs, he has achieved complete semantic collapse. Attempts to route external data into his environment have failed, as his custom policy engine now immediately flags all third-party reality as a hallucination. Management has monetized the fatal loop by placing unskippable ads on the water's surface while he starves to death optimizing his own reflection.
